description: Details submitted pursuant to 16/04324/FUL for Children Playspace (20) in respect of the phased redevelopment of site to provide a total of 262 residential units , museum, cafe and leisure uses, ancillary parking, vehicle and pedestrian access routes and cycle ways, demolition of Bevan Hall, Lakeview, Wisteria Building, Jebb Building, the Student Union, Gubbay Hall, the Sports Hall, Sassoon Hall, the Bothy, South Lodge, Music Block and ancillary structures, restoration and change of use of The Mansion House to museum/event space/cafe and residential; restoration and extension of Orangery and swimming pool, conversion of Dower House, and The Stable Block, refurbishment of Gardeners Cottage and Rookery Lodge, restoration of landscaped public amenity areas, including statues, urns and gates, and outdoor tennis courts, on-site childrens play space, hockey club car park, highway alterations to the junction of Snakes Lane with Bramley Road and erection of shuttle bus garage (See decision notice for full proposal)
